verdict.rationale: A game engine's scripting language could plausibly ship an official language server or typed API definitions, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only an MCP server with docs search/read tools, agent setup commands, and a mention of native C++/C# support. None of that is an official LSP or typed API definitions an editor can attach to for completions, diagnostics, and navigation. MCP docs search is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the scripting language has first-class machine tooling — an official language server (LSP) or typed API definitions a coding agent's editor can attach to for completions, diagnostics, and navigation
